items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: So I played, I beat snare drum in the parade... I played, you know, with the band that way.

ctx.x: Never worked with my brother in anything.

Never worked with them again? Never had, no. The only time, the closest I come around my brother playing, when I was living out here, I went back to Chicago. The Elf Convention in Chicago and the Elf had a brass band here, and Papa Mudd at the time had an eight piece band out here, and they hired this band to play for their balls on the way back. See we played one in San Francisco, one in Oakland, one in Denver, Salt Lake, and St. Louis in Chicago. In the meantime we were hired to play with the brass band in the…

I was going to ask too about any regular formal lessons, if you, when you learned to play drums, did your brother show you how to hold the sticks a little bit, or did you ever have a book that you learned in? No, he showed me how to hold the sticks.
